mapLocation.label: Talk to Ceril Carnillean in East Ardougne, just north of the Clock Tower.

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Speak with Ceril Carnillean ( of the house south-west of East Ardougne castle) Dialogue: "What's wrong?", "Yes."
Siding with Ceril will reward 5 additional coins and gives you the option to obtain Carnillean armour, although this armour has lower defensive bonuses than an iron platebody.
Siding with Hazeel will reward the Hazeel's mark, which is a purely cosmetic reward.
Turn Valve 1 LEFT
Turn Valve 2 RIGHT
Turn Valve 3 RIGHT
Turn Valve 4 RIGHT
Turn Valve 5 RIGHT
Enter the Ardougne Sewers east of the clocktower (south of Valve 1) and talk to Clivet Dialogue: "Alright, I've made my decision.", "I won't help you."
Board the raft, and talk to Alomone to the south.
Kill Alomone and loot the Carnillean armour from the chest.
Board the raft again and run back to the Carnilleans house.
Talk to Ceril Carnillean (quest incomplete!)
Search the cupboard in the room upstairs east of the staircase to find the evidence.

Enter the Ardougne Sewers east of the clocktower (south of Valve 1) and talk to Clivet to receive a bottle of poison Dialogue: "Alright, I've made my decision.", "I'll help you.", "Alright, how do I do it?"
Turn Valve 1 LEFT
Turn Valve 2 RIGHT
Turn Valve 3 RIGHT
Go to the basement of the Carnilleans house (ladder)
Use the bottle of poison on the cooking range.
Talk to Ceril on the .
Talk to Clivet.
Turn Valve 4 RIGHT
Turn Valve 5 RIGHT
Go back to the cave and board the raft.
Talk to Alomone.
Go back to the Carnilleans' house.
Talk to Butler Jones.
Go in the basement and search the crate for a Chest key.
Go up the ladder and stairs and knock on the wall in the east room, and go up the ladder.
Unlock and search the chest to find the scroll.
Return to Alomone.
